name: OpenSIPS IMS Community Edition
what_it_is: A fully functional 3GPP-compliant IMS CSCF stack (P-CSCF, I-CSCF, S-CSCF) built on OpenSIPS, designed to integrate with Dockerized Open5GS 4G/5G core networks. It provides VoLTE SIP signaling, registration, authentication, and media relay in an all-in-one docker-compose environment.
components: P-CSCF (opensips/opensips:ims-ce) — SIP entry point, NAT traversal, security
I-CSCF (opensips/opensips:ims-ce) — inter-network SIP routing and HSS query
S-CSCF (opensips/opensips:ims-ce) — user registration, authentication, session routing
pyHSS — Python-based HSS exposing Diameter Cx/Sh interfaces and REST API on port 8080
RTPEngine — media relay and transcoding (ports 49000-50000 UDP)
Open5GS EPC — MME, SMF, UPF, SGW-C/U, PCRF, HSS forming the 4G core
MySQL — IMS subscriber and routing database
DNS — internal resolution for IMS domain names
protocols: SIP (RFC 3261) — call session control across P/I/S-CSCF
Diameter Cx — HSS-CSCF interface for authentication and registration
measurement: Prometheus scrape endpoint exposed by metrics service on port 9090
Grafana dashboards on port 3000 (grafana/grafana:11.3.0) for visualization
Centralised log volume at ./log shared across all services
pyHSS REST API on port 8080 for subscriber and session state inspection
configuration: All services configured via a single .env file (TEST_NETWORK subnet, domain names, credentials)
Per-component environment variables injected at container startup
MySQL initialised from docker_mysql image with persistent dbdata volume
MongoDB persistence via mongodbdata volume; Open5GS WebUI at port 9999 for subscriber provisioning
Timezone consistency enforced by bind-mounting host /etc/localtime and /etc/timezone into every container
modes: Standalone IMS-CE mode: P/I/S-CSCF + pyHSS + RTPEngine only (drop-in replacement for existing Open5GS IMS)
Full-stack mode: complete docker-compose with embedded Open5GS 4G EPC + IMS + SMS path
constraints: Requires privileged container capabilities (NET_ADMIN) for P-CSCF, UPF, and RTPEngine — not suitable for unprivileged sandbox environments
No built-in fault injection or chaos tooling; resilience testing requires external tooling
SMS path depends on OsmoMSC/OsmoHLR and Kamailio SMSC, adding significant operational complexity
Open5GS EPC components use custom docker_open5gs image that must be built locally before first run
All 24 services share a single flat TEST_NETWORK subnet; no network segmentation between core and IMS planes
notable_absences: No fault injection or chaos engineering hooks
No load/performance test harness included in the repo
No TLS/IPsec configuration for Ut/Gm interfaces documented
No 5G SA (standalone) core integration — only 4G EPC (NSA path)
No call-detail-record (CDR) or billing interface (no Rf/Ro Diameter)
